text:
Tao: Heads-up — I'm flying into SF on Thu, any go-to dinner spots near 1st & Mission? not too fancy, good for 3 people.
Emma K.: For 1st & Mission check out The Bird (fried chicken sandwiches) or Mission Chinese for spice. both ~10–15 min walk.
Raj P.: +1 Mission Chinese. If you want quieter: La Taqueria is solid (grab & go).
Maria G.: If you want sit-down and veggie-friendly: Flour + Water is a bit farther but excellent pasta.
Tao: Thanks! Any spots open late? arriving ~8:30pm.
Emma K.: The Bird closes at 9 on weekdays, Taqueria till late, and there's a taco truck on Folsom that's great after shows.
Raj P.: If you're near SoMa, try "The Peruvian Place" on 2nd, open till 10.
lunch-bot: Weekly SF office picks — Monday: BaoHaus, Tuesday: Ramen Tatsu-ya, Wed: Pizza, Thu: Mission Chinese special
Tao: Sweet, I'll try Mission Chinese. Anyone want to join? 12:30pm tomorrow? @Emma K. @Maria G.
Emma K.: Not tomorrow but FYI I recommend booking; it gets packed.
Maria G.: I'm in! 12:30 works :thumbsup: 
Raj P.: Slightly off-topic — traveling to Berlin next week, any currywurst recs? :de: 
Emma K.: Curry 36 or Konnopke's for classic spots. For schnitzel try Schnitzelwirt.
Tao: Perfect, thanks. Also, any budget hotel recs near Alexanderplatz?
Maria G.: Generator Hostel area is okay and central, or Hotel Indigo for midrange.
Emma K.: Sharing this MR for food lovers: https://bit.ly/sf-eats — compiled by ops last quarter.
Tao: Awesome, saved.
